summary.text: Dave Foggin is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates who has represented District 14 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former physics teacher.

paragraphs.text: Dave Foggin was born in Parkersburg, West Virginia.
He earned a B.S. in chemical engineering and an M.A. in secondary education, and he has training as an EMT.
His career experience includes working as a physics teacher.
